about.metaDescription: Get to know the story, mission and team of NGO DI MI PA BÔS, dedicated to transforming lives in Guinea-Bissau.
about.heroDescription: DI MI PA BÔS (also known as dimipabos) is an NGO in Guinea-Bissau, based in Bissau. We were born from the urgent need to offer adequate, humane treatment to people facing chemical dependency, and our mission is to build and operate the country's first specialised centre.
about.cardBody: We work tirelessly to build a space of shelter and recovery, where every person can find the support they need to start again.
historyParagraphs: NGO DI MI PA BÔS was founded in 2021 with a simple, essential purpose: to bring help to those who need it most. At first our focus was on donations, providing basic support to vulnerable people in Guinea-Bissau. Along the way, however, we recognised an even greater need — a safe, structured space to welcome and treat people struggling with chemical dependency.

From that realisation our flagship project was born: building a shelter and treatment centre for people facing challenges with substance use. The centre will be a place where they can recover with dignity, receiving appropriate treatment and continuous follow-up to ensure their rehabilitation and reintegration into society.

We are still in the construction phase, but every step we take is driven by our commitment to transforming lives. With the support of our community, partners and donors, we are building a future where more people get the chance to start over.
Join us on this mission and help make this dream a reality! 💙✨

centro-tratamento.title: Treatment and Rehabilitation Centre
centro-tratamento.description: The first specialised treatment and rehabilitation centre for people facing chemical dependency in Guinea-Bissau.
centro-tratamento.shortDescription: Specialised treatment with a multidisciplinary team.
centro-tratamento.longDescription:
Our flagship project is the construction of a modern, humane treatment centre. With the land already acquired in 2023, we are now in the fundraising phase to begin construction.

The centre will be equipped with:
• Dormitories for up to 20 people
• Communal and leisure areas
• Rooms for individual and group sessions
• Dining hall and industrial kitchen
• Space for therapeutic activities

privacyPolicy.metaDescription: How DI MI PA BÔS collects, uses and protects the personal data of this website's visitors.
privacyPolicy.heroDescription: This policy describes how DI MI PA BÔS collects, uses and protects your personal data when you interact with this website.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is DI MI PA BÔS (Non-Governmental Organisation), tax identification number 910324840, with its registered office in Bissau, Guinea-Bissau, Republic of Guinea-Bissau.
For any question regarding the processing of your data, you can contact us at privacidade@ongdimipabos.org.

sections.title: 2. Personal data collected
paragraphs: We only collect the data necessary to operate the services made available on this website, as indicated in the forms we provide. Specifically, we may collect:
list: Identification and contact data voluntarily provided in forms (name, email address, phone, message).
Data associated with donations, where applicable, processed directly by the payment service provider that may be engaged.
Technical data automatically collected by our infrastructure provider (IP address, browser type, access date and time), exclusively for security and site operation purposes.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: We process your personal data for the following purposes:
list: To respond to contact requests, volunteer applications and partnership proposals submitted through the website's forms (performance of pre-contractual steps and legitimate interest).
To process donations, issue receipts and comply with related legal and accounting obligations (compliance with legal obligation and contract performance).
To ensure the security, integrity and technical operation of the website (legitimate interest).

sections.title: 4. Sub-processors
paragraphs: To provide our services we rely on suppliers acting as sub-processors, bound by contractual obligations of confidentiality and data protection:
list: Cloudflare, Inc., for hosting, distribution and security of the website and its digital assets.
A payment service provider, to be announced in due course, for the processing of electronic donations.

sections.title: 5. International data transfers
paragraphs: Some of our sub-processors are based outside Guinea-Bissau and the European Economic Area, in particular in the United States of America. Whenever international data transfers occur, we ensure that they are carried out on the basis of appropriate safeguards, in particular the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, where applicable.

sections.title: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: Your personal data is kept only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, or for the legally required period. Messages sent through the website's forms are kept for as long as needed for their processing and historical archive, and may be deleted at the data subject's request. Records associated with donations are kept for the periods required by the applicable accounting and tax legislation.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: As a data subject, you have the following rights:
list: Right to access your personal data.
Right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete data.
Right to erasure of data, in the cases provided for by law.
Right to restrict and object to processing, in the cases legally permitted.
Right to data portability, where applicable.
Right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: This website uses only cookies and similar technologies strictly necessary for its operation, and does not use advertising or behavioural tracking cookies that require prior consent. For statistical purposes we use a cookieless analytics solution (PostHog), hosted in the European Union and configured without cookies, without storage on your device and without collecting your IP address. For more details, see our Cookie Policy.

sections.title: 9. Contact
paragraphs: To exercise your rights or clarify any question about the processing of your personal data, contact us at privacidade@ongdimipabos.org or, alternatively, contact@ongdimipabos.org. We undertake to respond without undue delay and, in any case, within the legally applicable deadlines.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time to reflect legal, technical or operational changes. The version in force is always the one published on this page, identified by the last updated date shown at the top.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of use of the DI MI PA BÔS website and conditions applicable to donations.
terms.heroDescription: These terms govern the use of the DI MI PA BÔS website and the conditions applicable to donations and other interactions made available.

sections.title: 1. Identification
paragraphs: This website is owned and operated by DI MI PA BÔS (Non-Governmental Organisation), tax identification number 910324840, with its registered office in Bissau, Guinea-Bissau, Republic of Guinea-Bissau, reachable at contact@ongdimipabos.org.

sections.title: 2. Purpose
paragraphs: The purpose of this website is to present the mission, projects and initiatives of DI MI PA BÔS, and to allow visitors to contact the organisation, apply for volunteering, propose partnerships and contribute through donations.
Use of the website implies full acceptance of these terms and of the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 3. Donations
paragraphs: Donations made through this website are voluntary and are used entirely to fund the activities and projects of DI MI PA BÔS, and may be allocated to any area of intervention according to the operational needs of the organisation, unless expressly stated otherwise at the time of donation.

A donation is considered complete when the transaction is confirmed by the payment service provider. As donations are gratuitous and without consideration, they are, as a rule, final and non-refundable.

sections.title: 4. Refund requests
paragraphs: Without prejudice to the final nature of donations, the donor may request the refund of a donation within fourteen (14) days of the donation date, in the event of proven error, duplicate payment, unauthorised transaction or other clearly justified circumstance.

Refund requests must be sent to donativos@ongdimipabos.org, stating the donor's name, the date, the donation amount and the reason for the request. The organisation undertakes to review and respond to each request in a timely manner.

sections.title: 5. Payment processing
paragraphs: Donations are processed by a third-party payment service provider, to be announced in due course on this page. DI MI PA BÔS does not collect or store card data or other sensitive payment data, that responsibility being entirely assumed by the provider, in accordance with the standards applicable to the payments industry.

sections.title: 6. Proofs and receipts
paragraphs: After each completed donation, the donor will receive an electronic proof issued by the payment service provider. Additional receipts may be requested on demand at donativos@ongdimipabos.org, providing the data needed for their issuance.

DI MI PA BÔS does not currently issue statements eligible for tax deduction in Portugal or other jurisdictions. The tax eligibility of a donation is the donor's responsibility and must be assessed in light of the legislation applicable in their country of residence.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content made available on this website, including texts, images, videos, logos, trademarks, illustrations and graphic elements, is the property of DI MI PA BÔS or of third parties who have authorised its use and is protected by the applicable intellectual property legislation.
Reproduction, distribution, modification or commercial use of the content without the prior, express authorisation of the organisation is prohibited, except for personal non-commercial use.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: DI MI PA BÔS makes its best efforts to ensure the accuracy and currency of the information made available on this website, but assumes no responsibility for any errors, omissions or occasional technical unavailability.

This website may contain links to external sites whose content and policies are the sole responsibility of the respective entities; no responsibility is assumed for their operation or for the practices of those entities.

sections.title: 9. Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Guinea-Bissau. Any dispute arising from their application or interpretation will be submitted to the competent courts of Bissau, without prejudice to mandatory legal jurisdictions applicable to consumers residing in other jurisdictions.

sections.title: 10. Changes

cookies.metaDescription: How DI MI PA BÔS uses strictly necessary cookies and cookieless analytics on this website.
cookies.heroDescription: This policy explains what cookies are, which cookies this website uses and how you can manage them.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files that websites place on your device to store information. They are widely used to make sites work and to gather information about how users interact with them. Similar technologies, such as browser local storage, perform equivalent functions.

sections.title: 2. Strictly necessary cookies
paragraphs: We use only cookies and similar technologies that are strictly necessary for the website to function. These cookies do not require prior consent and are not used for marketing or tracking purposes. Specifically, they may include:
list: Language preference, to display the website in your chosen language.
Security and technical operation cookies managed by our infrastructure provider (Cloudflare), to protect the site and ensure it works correctly.

sections.title: 3. Cookieless analytics
paragraphs: To understand in aggregate how the website is used, we rely on an analytics solution (PostHog) configured in cookieless mode. This solution does not place cookies on your device, does not use persistent local storage, does not collect your IP address and does not perform cross-site tracking or session recording.

The data is processed in aggregate and anonymously, exclusively for statistical purposes and to improve the website, and is hosted on servers located in the European Union. Because no information is stored on or read from your device, this analytics does not require your prior consent.

sections.title: 4. Third-party cookies
paragraphs: This website does not use advertising, social media or third-party behavioural tracking cookies. Should cookies requiring consent be introduced in the future, this policy will be updated and your appropriate consent will be requested before they are used.

sections.title: 5. How to manage cookies
paragraphs: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers let you block or delete cookies, as well as be notified whenever a cookie is set. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may affect how some features of the website work.

sections.title: 6. Contact
paragraphs: For any question about the use of cookies on this website, contact us at privacidade@ongdimipabos.org. For more information about the processing of your personal data, see our Privacy Policy.
